title: Mirror Trading International Basics - The Binary
description: Understanding the basics, how the MTI Binary Works Join the official MTI Members News Channel on Telegram ...

asr.full_text: MTI the binary people often ask how much they must put into their trading pool to get so much per month you will need to put in roughly 10 times what you expect to get monthly if you just want to be a normal member but why be normal use the MT is system to your advantage and build a business gather a team of people and earn the binary bonus how can you earn binary bonuses from Meritrading International? You need to have at least $200 in your own Trading Pool account. Then introduce someone in the right hand side and left hand side of the business. Every member of MTI has two legs, one that your team leader and other members in your team will add people to and another leg where only you can add members. These legs grow when you and other people continue adding people. Your team leader and other members above you will be adding people into one leg which is known as the power leg. You and people you have joined will add people into the other leg which is known as the profit leg. Once you are binary qualified, you will receive a binary bonus every Saturday from whichever of these legs is the smallest in terms of money invested. It is not necessary to recruit people into mirror trading international as you learn from the daily trading activities. But as you can see, you will earn good bonuses weekly if you build a team. For more information, please contact the person who sent you this video.

It also promotes team-based investment and recurring bonuses as a route to weekly earnings, with instructions to contact the sender through Telegram for follow-up.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted binary bonus depends on introducing people into a two-leg team structure, with qualification and bonus calculation tied to the legs and their invested amounts.
